overview_text: The combined degree in economics and criminal justice offers an interdisciplinary approach, integrating economic principles with the study of criminal justice. Students will explore how economic factors influence crime and have an opportunity to master tools for evaluating criminal justice policies and understand the connections between economic processes and criminal justice systems. Successful graduates with this degree will be prepared for diverse careers in economics, criminal justice, financial crime investigations, and public policy.
